planSteps.description: Navigate to the app in a fresh browser session
Enter https://github.com/TestSprite/testsprite-cli/pull/218 and click Inspect PR. Wait for the PR title and head SHA.

Click the toolbar button with the accessible name and title "Download evidence report" (the downward-arrow download icon next to Refresh evidence). This is a separate button, not the Report tab. Wait for the browser download triggered by this click.

Verify the browser actually downloaded a file named PR-218-evidence.md, and read that file. Its Markdown must contain https://github.com/TestSprite/testsprite-cli/pull/218, the full head SHA 79054cff490203c7ae4b6bb3ca4f737734cabd9e, and a Scope section. Displaying the report in the page alone is not a pass.
